pages.title: Fish Sort
pages.creator: GameDev.Land
pages.description: Fish Sort is a puzzle about grouping fish by color on seaweed branches. Move a fish to an empty spot or onto another fish of the same color. Leave yourself room to move fish out of the way when a branch is crowded. Finish the level by sorting every fish into its color group.

pages.title: Soccer Duel
pages.creator: Illusions Games
pages.description: Soccer Duel brings table football to matches you can play alone or with a friend. Use your side to send the ball toward the other goal and cover your own when possession changes. Share a device for a local match or connect over the network to play from different devices.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Wonders of Egypt
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Wonders of Egypt sets a bubble puzzle against changing desert backdrops. Aim at matching bubbles or bank a shot off the wall to reach an awkward group. Missed shots bring the next row closer, so check the preview before you fire. Raise your score to unlock the Medium and Hard difficulties.

pages.title: Nautilus Spaceship Escape
pages.creator: playit-online
pages.description: Nautilus Spaceship Escape begins when a brief power outage wakes you aboard a quiet spacecraft. Explore the Nautilus and examine your surroundings for clues to what happened. Use what you find to work out how to get farther through the ship. The mystery unfolds as you investigate the areas around you.

pages.title: Screw Masters 3D Puzzle
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Screw Masters 3D Puzzle asks you to dismantle objects by removing their screws. Inspect how the parts are attached before choosing which fastener to take out. Work through the model piece by piece until it comes apart. Use the available bonuses when a difficult arrangement keeps you from reaching the next part.

pages.title: Merge Christmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Merge Christmas is a winter puzzle where matching snowballs combine into bigger ones with new characters. Bring the same designs together and plan where each larger snowball will end up. Leave room for later merges as the pieces grow. Keep combining them to discover more of the Christmas set.

pages.title: Zombies: Battle for Survival
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Zombies: Battle for Survival pits you against waves that get tougher as the fight goes on. Watch your ammunition, buy weapons and upgrade your gear when you get the chance. Open new areas and build barricades to slow the undead. See how long you can keep the defense going before the horde gets through.

pages.title: Horror Minecraft Partytime
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Horror Minecraft Partytime puts you on the searching side of a hide-and-seek match in a blocky world. Check corners and look for an out-of-place object that could be a character in disguise. Move through the area carefully and catch the hidden player once you work out where they are.

pages.title: Puzzles Balls Merge the New Year!
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Puzzles Balls Merge the New Year! gives you a board to fill with holiday balls. Drop matching balls close enough to touch so they combine into a larger one. Choose where each drop lands and keep space for the next piece. Build your score as you work toward making the biggest ball.

pages.title: Money Grabber
pages.creator: Cybernaut Games
pages.description: Money Grabber is a defense game about catching cash before it reaches a shredder. Improve the machines that intercept the money and use cards to change what your setup can do. Spend coins on machine upgrades and gems to draw more cards. Build a setup that can save more of the next batch.

pages.title: Super Pony World
pages.creator: ALMA Games
pages.description: Super Pony World follows a unicorn through platforming courses filled with coins and puzzles. Press Space to jump and hold it to glide over longer gaps. Watch for rabbits and mosquitoes as you move through the terrain. Collect coins you can reach safely and work through the puzzles to keep going.

pages.title: Num Bubbles Merging
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Num Bubbles Merging is a number puzzle where you launch one bubble into another. Tap a bubble, point its arrow at the one you want to hit and release. Check the numbers before lining up a merge so the result matches the current target. Make ten bubbles with that value to clear the level.

pages.title: Poo Hammer
pages.creator: Eugen Chepurniy
pages.description: Poo Hammer is a pixel platformer with four hazardous locations. Jump past obstacles and attack enemies as you make your way through each stage. Different opponents call for different timing, so watch how they move before getting close. Each location ends with a boss that puts those skills to use.

pages.title: Treasures of The Sea
pages.creator: Filgame
pages.description: Treasures of The Sea is a pirate-themed matching puzzle with forty levels. Line up three or more identical items to remove them from the board. Look at which matches will make room for another move and work through each layout. The levels take you farther into the search for hidden pirate treasure.

pages.title: Mike And Mia The Firefighter
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Mike And Mia The Firefighter puts two young firefighters on an emergency call. Pick their outfits and decorate the wagon before taking it to the rescue. Help them save the cats and put out the flames when they arrive. The game moves from getting the crew ready to handling the fire.

pages.title: Flipper Dunk 3D
pages.creator: Armath
pages.description: Flipper Dunk 3D is a basketball game where a single tap sends the ball toward the hoop. Wait until the ball is in a good position before using the flipper. Watch how it travels after each hit and adjust your timing on the next try. Land the ball in the basket to score.

pages.title: Blind Bat
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Blind Bat sends a bat flying through the countryside with birds in its path. Fire when you have a shot and keep track of the ammunition you have left. If you run out, the birds can attack you. Choose each shot carefully as you try to keep the bat in the air.

pages.title: Over Rooftops
pages.creator: Amr Osama
pages.description: Over Rooftops puts you in control of a cat running across roofs at night. Jump the gaps and pick up fish falling from the plane. When a creature gets in your way, meow to deal with it. Watch the edge of each roof as you line up the next jump.

pages.title: City Ambulance Car Driving
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description: City Ambulance Car Driving puts you on emergency calls in a busy city. Pick up patients at accident sites and take them to the hospital. Use the siren to get through traffic, then drive smoothly once the patient is aboard. Balance speed with a steady ride so you can arrive quickly and safely.

pages.title: ROD Multiplayer Car Driving
pages.creator: Inspector Studios
pages.description: ROD Multiplayer Car Driving gives you a 3D city for street races, drifting and stunt driving. Take a car into an online race or practice turns around the city. Drive with the arrow keys and press T to place a ramp ahead of you. Try a jump or return to the streets to race other drivers.

pages.title: Car Traffic Race
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Car Traffic Race is an endless lane-dodging game. Guide your car around the other vehicles and pick up gold coins when the road gives you room. Look ahead so you can spot an open route before the next car gets close. Keep the run going and try to beat your previous record.

pages.title: Frogie Cross The Road
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Frogie Cross The Road asks you to get a frog to the far side. Watch for gaps in traffic before crossing and take care around the water. Stop in a safe spot when you need time to check the next move. Make the crossing alone or share the challenge in two-player mode.

pages.title: Hexa Merge
pages.creator: Dinmo Games
pages.description: Hexa Merge is a number puzzle played on a hexagonal grid. Select a block and move it into an empty cell next to a block with the same number and color. Bring matching pieces together to make a new value. With no timer, you can plan where to leave room for the next merge.

pages.title: City Siege Sniper
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: City Siege Sniper sends you through twenty-five missions on SNAFU Island. Throw stones to distract enemies and give civilians time to escape, then use cover and pick the right weapon for the fight. Upgrade your arsenal between missions. Call in an air strike when you need to hit a larger area.

pages.title: Santa Claus Jumping
pages.creator: Baby Daisy Games
pages.description: Santa Claus Jumping is a timing game with sharp ice above Santa. Make each jump high enough to reach the platform and earn a point. Jump too high and Santa hits the ice. Watch the distance between the platform and the spikes as you try to keep adding to your score.

pages.title: Sausage Dog
pages.creator: Functu
pages.description: Sausage Dog is a platform adventure where you guide a dachshund through increasingly difficult levels. Use the arrow keys to move and interact with objects. Look for levers and buttons when a barrier blocks the way, and watch how the platforms move. Pick up items as you explore and find a route through each stage.

pages.title: Alien Mahjong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Alien Mahjong is a tile-matching puzzle with three layouts. Find at least two identical tiles and clear them, then look for another group in the space they leave. If no matches remain, use bomb mode to create new options. Keep finding groups until every tile is gone from the level.

pages.title: Santa's Christmas Fishing
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Santa's Christmas Fishing takes Santa out to catch fish and see what lies deeper in the water. Tap to lower the hook, then swipe to catch fish, diamonds and gifts while avoiding garbage. Improve your bucket and fishing depth between trips. Floating presents contain decorations for the tree in Santa's room.

pages.title: Santa Christmas Delivery
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Santa Christmas Delivery is a holiday chase game about dropping off presents while the Grinch tries to take them. Guide Santa to the delivery stops and keep out of the Grinch's reach along the way. Watch where he is approaching from as you pick the next route through the Christmas night.

pages.title: Truck Climber
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Truck Climber puts you in charge of a truck on rocky courses. Tilt the vehicle as you climb and bring it back level before landing. Rolling it onto its roof sends you back to try again. Get over the rocks and cross the finish line to complete each stage.

pages.title: Escape
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Escape is an arcade game where the goal is to keep a ball inside a circle. Turn to cover the part of the boundary the ball is approaching and think about where it will rebound. Pick up gems inside the ring and stay in play as long as you can.

pages.title: Turquoise Blocks
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Turquoise Blocks gives you three shapes at a time to place on a grid. Fill rows or columns to score and watch the gold timer bar as you work. Collect coins for tools that can rotate the board, move fixed blocks or delete pieces. Use them to make room for your next placement.

pages.title: Snowball Throw
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Snowball Throw gives you six snowballs and adds the distance of each throw to your score. Try to get as much distance as possible and watch for pickups along the way. Extra lives give you more throws. Silver and gold stars add different amounts to the running total.

pages.title: Ninja Frog
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Ninja Frog is a platform game with five levels. Jump between ledges, break boxes and collect strawberries along the route. Land on enemies from above while staying clear of spikes and blades. Check the next landing before attempting a long jump so you can keep the frog moving toward the finish.

pages.title: Douchebag Workout
pages.creator: Games Media
pages.description: Douchebag Workout is a satirical gym game where you build up a character's physique and style. Work through exercises, develop his arms and abs, and change his appearance with a tan and new gear. Decide where to spend your time as you work toward the game's exaggerated version of gym status.

pages.title: Farm Hero
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Farm Hero is a rescue puzzle set after a flood scatters the farm animals. Move them into positions where they connect in the shape shown for the level. Look at how each animal fits into the pattern before joining the pieces. Recreate the target shape to bring the animals together safely.

pages.title: Ski Xmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Ski Xmas sends Santa down a mountain with an avalanche behind him. Steer through the descent and gather gifts while keeping ahead of the snow. Use the shop to improve Santa's abilities. Try to ski farther on later runs to unlock hidden characters and raise your best score.

pages.title: Spinball 3D
pages.creator: Spinball
pages.description: Spinball 3D brings paddle tennis into a three-dimensional court. Swipe the paddle as you hit to put spin on the ball and make its path curve. Try sidespin to send a return away from the computer's reach. The opponent gets tougher as you advance, and you can compare your score with other players.

pages.title: Baby Taylor Fairy Land Dream
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Baby Taylor Fairy Land Dream follows Taylor after she meets a princess in a world damaged by a witch. Help Taylor find the magical materials needed to rebuild Fairy Land. Search the places she visits and collect what the princess needs. Each discovery helps the two of them restore more of the world.

pages.title: Coloring Birds Game
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Coloring Birds Game gives you cartoon bird pictures to color. Choose colors for the feathers, beaks and other parts of each design. Try one palette across the picture or give each detail its own shade. Pick a different bird when you want a new outline to work with.

pages.title: Unnamed Dodger Test
pages.creator: GGMagenta
pages.description: Unnamed Dodger Test gives you sixteen waves of hazards, each with a different pattern. Stay close to the target to damage it, but avoid touching it while dodging the rest. To reach the bonus wave, finish in under 240 seconds with at least 70 health on the same run.

pages.title: Color Maze
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Color Maze sends a colored square through a maze of colored barriers. Use the arrow keys to move toward a passage that matches the square. Pickups can change your color, so check it again before crossing the next barrier. A mismatch ends the run. Keep moving through the maze to build your score.

pages.title: Wolf Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Wolf Jigsaw gives you six wolf pictures to assemble. Finish the first puzzle to unlock the next image, then continue through the collection. Choose 25, 49 or 100 pieces for each picture. Use the lines and colors around the wolves to find pieces that fit together as the picture takes shape.

pages.title: Water Slide Car Racing adventure 2020
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Water Slide Car Racing adventure 2020 takes a car onto water slides for driving and stunt challenges. Follow the bends as the slide carries you through the course. Pay attention to the next section before steering into a turn. Try to keep the car under control as you move through the watery route.

pages.title: Police Car Parking Mania Car Driving Games
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Police Car Parking Mania Car Driving Games puts you behind the wheel of a police vehicle for parking challenges. Drive through the course and line the car up with the space. Watch the edges as you turn and leave enough room to straighten out. Work through the levels as the parking setups change.

pages.title: Donut Crash Saga
pages.creator: y9-games.com
pages.description: Donut Crash Saga is a match-three game about lining up doughnuts of the same color. Make groups of at least three to score and keep an eye on the gauge at the left. If it drops too low, the game ends. Spot the next match while the board is changing to keep the round going.

pages.title: Beach Back Spa salon
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Beach Back Spa salon follows Clara and Mia on a trip to a beach salon. Give each princess a back treatment, then choose outfits for them after the spa session. Work through the salon steps before trying different clothes. The game takes the two friends from the treatment table to their finished looks.

pages.title: Iron Master
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Iron Master is a timing and control game about ironing clothes. Move the iron with the mouse and work across the fabric to smooth it out. Check which parts still need attention before moving on. Finish the garment properly to clear the level and get another piece of clothing to iron.

pages.title: Valentine Young Love Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Valentine Young Love Puzzle lets you assemble six Valentine-themed pictures. Choose a layout of 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces, then look for edges and details that continue from one piece to the next. Finish the picture you chose or change the piece count to work through it with smaller fragments.

pages.title: Fly Plane
pages.creator: Nela´s games
pages.description: Fly Plane is a flight game controlled by tapping. Keep the plane in the air as you thread between rocks that jut down from the ceiling and up from the ground. Watch for enemy planes and shields along the route. Time your taps around each opening to see how far you can fly.

pages.title: Dinosaurs Coloring Book Part I
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dinosaurs Coloring Book Part I gives you dinosaur outlines to color across several levels. Choose a palette and work through the shapes, picking out features such as the body, head and tail in different shades. Finish one picture and move to another dinosaur to try a new combination of colors.

pages.title: Flick Snowball Xmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Flick Snowball Xmas gives you a snowball and a basket to aim for. Flick the snowball and see whether the shot carries it into the basket. Adjust the next flick based on where it lands. Try to keep scoring as you work toward a higher total than your last run.

pages.title: The Impossible Dash
pages.creator: GameNing
pages.description: The Impossible Dash has seven obstacle courses to get through. Click to move when a hazard gets close and time the change so you pass without a collision. Watch the layout ahead, since each level has a different set of obstacles. Keep moving through the safe gaps until you reach the end.

pages.title: Basketball Shot
pages.creator: DITGAMES
pages.description: Basketball Shot is a score challenge about getting the ball into the hoop. Judge the strength and direction of each shot before releasing it. If the ball falls short or goes too far, adjust the next attempt. Make as many baskets as you can to try to beat your record.

pages.title: Urban Derby Stunt and Drift
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Urban Derby Stunt and Drift gives you room to drive freely and practice stunts. Perform tricks and collect coins to earn money for more vehicles. Try the available cars to see how their handling changes as you drift. Explore the map between challenges or take on the levels when you want a specific course.

pages.title: Juice Master
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Juice Master turns fruit cutting into a game about making mixed juice. Cut the fruit that appears and work through the ingredients needed for each drink. Watch where the pieces are before making the next cut. Use the sliced fruit to finish a blend and move on to another juice.

pages.title: Jungle Treasure
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Jungle Treasure is a side-scrolling runner where the character moves automatically. Tap to jump over obstacles before they reach you. Watch the ground ahead so you can time each jump and land with enough space for the next one. Keep the runner moving as far through the jungle as you can.

pages.title: Fiat 500X Sport Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Fiat 500X Sport Puzzle gives you six photos of the Fiat 500X Sport to assemble. Choose 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Match details such as the outline of the body or the colors of the background to rebuild the picture. Increase the piece count for a more demanding version of the same image.

pages.title: EG Crossword Kids
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Crossword Kids gives you open books filled with numbers. Look across the pages and click or tap the number that differs from the others. Watch the timer while you compare the numbers. Work through the later sets as they change, checking each page carefully before you choose.

pages.title: Furious Car Racing 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Furious Car Racing 3D puts you in the cockpit on an endless drive through traffic. Use the view from inside the car to spot openings and avoid other vehicles. Try a different car or location as you get used to judging the space between lanes. See how far you can keep driving.

pages.title: Jewels Match
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Jewels Match is a match-three puzzle where groups of matching gems clear from the board. Look at how the jewels are arranged and make a match of at least three. Check what moves into the gap after a clear so you can set up another match with the pieces that remain.

pages.title: ii
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: In ii, the challenge is to attach dots to two rotating circles. Click to launch a dot when a gap is lined up with its path. Watch where the attached dots are moving so the new one can land without a collision. Fit the remaining dots onto the circles as the gaps get smaller.

pages.title: Kids Hidden Stars
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Kids Hidden Stars asks you to search pictures for stars tucked into the scenery. Look along outlines and in small spaces where a star can blend in. Select each one when you find it and keep searching until the scene is clear. Finding all the stars opens the next level.

pages.title: Duck Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Duck Puzzle Challenge is a jigsaw game with duck pictures to put together. Place the pieces by looking for colors and lines that continue across their edges. Use the ducks and the details around them to see which pieces belong near each other. Fit the whole picture together to finish the puzzle.

pages.title: Jelly Friends
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Jelly Friends is a match-three puzzle where you swap neighboring pieces. Make a line of at least three of the same color to clear them. Larger combinations can create a special piece and earn more points. Look at what will drop into the empty spaces before deciding which two pieces to swap.

pages.title: Fit The Shape
pages.creator: Fr Games
pages.description: Fit The Shape is a timing game about choosing an obstacle with the same outline as yours. Jump left or right to line up with the right shape. Check what is ahead before switching sides, since hitting a different outline ends the attempt. Keep matching shapes as you move through the course.

pages.title: Google Feud
pages.creator: Yupi.io
pages.description: Google Feud asks you to guess how Google would complete the beginning of a search. Read the prompt and try a phrase that people might type next. See which completions match the hidden answers. The fun is in working out what else people search for when they start with the same words.

pages.title: Dangerous Turn
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Dangerous Turn asks you to keep a car on the road through a series of bends. Click or touch to turn and hold the input while the car follows the curve. Let go when it is lined up for the next stretch. Watch the timing so the car stays on the road.

pages.title: Seesawball
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Seesawball is a two-player contest where quick presses tilt a seesaw and send the ball toward a goal. Use W and the Up arrow or the touch controls. Watch where the ball rolls as both players press for control. Keep it away from your goal and be the first to score five.

pages.title: Box Runner!
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Box Runner! sends a runner through a 3D city. Collect gold coins and jump between buildings as the route keeps going. Check the distance to the next landing before you leap and watch for coins you can reach without missing the path. See how far you can get through the city.

pages.title: Lada Russian Car Drift
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Lada Russian Car Drift lets you customize a Lada 2105 and take it onto a drift track. Try your setup through the corners and get used to how the car responds when it slides. Change the car and run the track again if you want to see how a different build feels.

pages.title: Pixel SWAT Zombie Survival
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Pixel SWAT Zombie Survival is a first-person shooter set on blocky maps. Choose a map and take on missions against zombies or pixelated fighters. Watch for enemies as you move through the area and pick where to engage. The game offers offline survival so you can work through the fights on your own.

pages.title: Motor Model Dressup
pages.creator: DUGS
pages.description: Motor Model Dressup lets you get a model ready for an evening motor show. Look through the clothing options and try combinations on her before she goes out. Choose a style that suits the event and change pieces until the outfit comes together. The finished look is what she takes to the show.

pages.title: Princess Indian Gala Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Indian Gala Fashion follows Moana, Ariel and Elena as they get ready for a gala in India. Choose traditional Indian clothing and accessories for each princess. Try different combinations for the three guests, then see how their looks work together. Get them dressed for the evening with the Bollywood stars.

pages.title: Snoring Elephant puzzle [Transilvania]
pages.creator: ALMA Games
pages.description: Snoring Elephant puzzle [Transilvania] gives you an elephant to wake up using the other animals. Make them roll or jump and watch how their movement carries them toward him. Work out the order of moves for each setup. The puzzles use a Transilvania theme as you find new ways to stop the snoring.

pages.title: Mall Shopping Spree
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Mall Shopping Spree sends a group of girls to the mall to shop for clothes and accessories. Visit different stores and choose pieces to try on each shopper. See which items work together before moving on to the next shop. Put together outfits from the different things you find around the mall.

pages.title: Arrozoid
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Arrozoid is a shooting game where the targets are words on the screen. Watch the arrows and fire when their movement gives you a shot at a word. Timing matters because you have limited control over their direction. Try to hit the stationary targets as the arrows move around them.

pages.title: Beavus
pages.creator: Gameshot
pages.description: Beavus is a one-button platform game about gathering logs. Time your jumps so the beaver can reach wood on different parts of the course. Collect every log to make a tree stump with the exit appear. Head for that door once you have gathered the last piece of wood.

pages.title: Just Feed Me - Bloomy
pages.creator: Stegobubbles
pages.description: Just Feed Me - Bloomy lets you look after a creature from Fluorium-1403 that grows by eating. Give Bloomy food and watch how it changes as it fills up. Keep feeding it to see its later forms. The goal is to help the creature grow and reach the next stage of its evolution.

pages.title: Superheroes 1010
pages.creator: webofgrafix
pages.description: Superheroes 1010 gives you blocks to place on a grid. Fit the shapes together until they make a complete row or column. Only full lines earn points, so leave enough space to place awkward shapes later. Look at what a line will clear before deciding where to put the next piece.

pages.title: Sandwich Baker
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Sandwich Baker puts you behind a counter making sandwiches for customers. Look at the order and put together the requested ingredients before serving it. Pay attention to what each customer asks for as you move to the next sandwich. Work through the orders one at a time as they come in.

pages.title: Baby Bird flies in the Sky
pages.creator: LDGEngineering
pages.description: Baby Bird flies in the Sky is a tap-to-fly game about helping a young bird stay in the air. Time each tap to pass between the pipes without touching them. Look for power-ups when you have room to collect them. Keep watching the next gap so the bird can fly farther.

pages.title: PlayHeads Soccer AllWorld Cup
pages.creator: MokoGames
pages.description: PlayHeads Soccer AllWorld Cup is a physics football game with teams made up of monsters and humans. Move your player toward the ball and time your hits to send it toward the other goal. Watch how the ball bounces after each challenge and move back into position to cover a return.

pages.title: Mountain Mind
pages.creator: Whirlwind Games
pages.description: Mountain Mind is a memory game with pictures of hiking equipment. Turn cards over and remember which items appear so you can find matching pairs. Remove all the cards and see how quickly you can clear the board. When you have found all the gear, the game ends with a camping trip.

pages.title: Moorhuhn Pirates
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Moorhuhn Pirates takes the chicken shooting gallery into a pirate setting. Look for chickens as they come into view and take your shot while you can see them. Keep scanning the scene after each hit so you can find the next target. Try to hit as many chickens as you can.

pages.title: Football Headz Cup
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Football Headz Cup is an arcade football tournament. Pick a team and face the other side on a small pitch. Move toward the ball when you have a chance to attack and get back when it heads for your goal. Score enough to win the match and keep your team in the cup.

pages.title: Super Market Promoter Girls
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Super Market Promoter Girls gives you three store promoters to dress. Choose an outfit for each girl based on how you want her to represent the shop and its products. Add accessories and compare the looks as a group. Change individual pieces until all three are ready to work together.

pages.title: Climbing Ball
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Climbing Ball is a score-chasing game where you tap to make a ball jump upward. Watch the spikes along the sides as you time each hop. Keep the ball clear of hazards and try to climb farther than you did last time. The game records your best score so you can compare runs.
